name: Josh Pence
bio: Josh Pence (born June 8, 1982) is an American actor. He is best known for portraying Tyler Winklevoss’ body double in The Social Network (2010), as well as for his roles in The Dark Knight Rises (2012), Draft Day (2014), and La La Land (2016).
